stores.purpose: Account authentication, recovery, security and identity linkage
stores.fields: email/phone when configured, password hash, confirmation/recovery/security metadata, timestamps and provider metadata

retention.current_behavior: Managed by Supabase Auth account lifecycle; DPP deletion/retention policy not yet accepted

controls: R06 fixed recovery redirect and fragment consumption

stores.purpose: Tenant membership, roles and active organization authorization

retention.current_behavior: Rows persist until membership/user/organization lifecycle deletion or cascade; no time-based expiry

stores.purpose: Identify tenant organizations and route tenant-scoped records

retention.current_behavior: Persists until organization deletion; dependent DPP records use foreign-key lifecycle rules

stores.purpose: Maintain canonical battery model/item records required for DPP workflows
stores.fields: model/manufacturer/category, battery unique identifier, lifecycle status, canonical_data JSON, creator user ID, timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Persists until authorized lifecycle/deletion; no automatic time-based expiry

stores.minimization_note: canonical_data must remain product/business data; personal data should not be placed in flexible JSON without an approved catalog purpose

stores.purpose: Create versioned DPP passport projections with explicit public/private split
stores.fields: public_payload, private_payload, status, battery linkage, creator/change actor IDs, version timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Current passport plus version history persists; version history is append-oriented and has no accepted time-based retention

stores.purpose: Map, validate and transactionally commit imported DPP product data
stores.fields: source headers/mapping, normalized model/item JSON, validation errors, creator ID, processing timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Terminal invalid/committed import runs may be purged only after 30 days through owner/admin dpp_api_purge_import_staging(); staged/validated runs are preserved; final accepted policy remains pending.

controls: R08 owner/admin terminal staging purge with immutable audit DELETE evidence

stores.purpose: Track DPP registry request/response state, retries, external references and idempotency
stores.location: Supabase Postgres public DPP namespace; approved payload may later be transmitted to external registry provider
stores.fields: request/response payloads, external reference, provider/environment/status, errors/retries, creator ID, timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Submission history persists; obvious credential-bearing JSON keys are technically blocked from request/response payload storage. Legal/operational retention and external-recipient terms are not yet accepted.

controls: recursive fail-closed credential-key guard on request_payload/response_payload
guard helper and trigger function not client-executable
stores.minimization_note: Registry request/response JSON must not persist obvious credential-bearing keys. Provider/legal payload scope and retention terms still require acceptance before live delivery.

stores.purpose: Attach evidence to DPP records with integrity metadata
stores.location: Metadata in Supabase Postgres; private object bytes in Supabase Storage bucket dpp-evidence via caller-JWT Edge Function dpp-evidence-object
stores.fields: storage path, original filename, content type, size, SHA-256, metadata JSON, creator ID, timestamps; object bytes may contain documents/images

retention.current_behavior: Metadata and private object bytes persist; deployed upload path verifies byte_size/SHA-256/content_type before Storage write. Final authenticated upload→download→delete lifecycle and accepted retention period remain pending.

controls: private dpp-evidence Storage bucket with tenant RLS
stores.minimization_note: filenames, metadata and evidence files may contain personal data and require explicit minimization/redaction rules before production

stores.purpose: Maintain immutable accountability trail for DPP record changes
stores.fields: actor_id, organization_id, action, target identifiers, before/after JSON snapshots, timestamp

retention.current_behavior: Audit rows remain append-only/immutable. Before/after snapshots now recursively redact values under obvious credential-bearing JSON keys before insertion; accepted retention period and broader minimization/deletion exceptions remain pending.

controls: recursive audit-only credential-key redaction before immutable insert
source rows are not modified by audit redaction
redaction helper has no anon/authenticated EXECUTE
stores.retention_risk: Credential-like JSON keys are technically redacted from audit copies, but broader personal/confidential-field minimization and accepted audit retention/deletion exceptions still require policy review.

stores.purpose: Bind DPP app/repository namespace and prevent cross-project confusion
stores.fields: app key, repository name, binding mode, notes, timestamp

retention.current_behavior: Retained while the DPP application binding exists

stores.purpose: Abuse prevention before upstream API work, with shared authenticated budgets prepared for distributed enforcement
stores.location: Process-local serverless memory plus Supabase Postgres DPP namespace for authenticated shared buckets
stores.processor: Application runtime/Vercel when deployed; Supabase for shared authenticated counters
stores.fields: truncated SHA-256 network/Authorization-derived bucket digests, surface/rule namespace, request counters and fixed-window timestamps; raw IP addresses and bearer credentials are not stored

retention.current_behavior: Process-local entries are pruned/capped; shared authenticated rows are opportunistically deleted after their reset time is older than 10 minutes. Final deployed distributed/public-endpoint policy remains unaccepted.

controls: raw IP and bearer token are never stored in bucket keys
direct anon/authenticated table privileges revoked with RLS enabled
shared consume RPC requires authenticated request-user context and validated pseudonymous key format
canonical 429 behavior remains process-local until shared runtime wiring is accepted

stores.purpose: Request correlation, failure diagnosis and security/availability monitoring without storing DPP payloads or credentials
stores.location: Vercel runtime logs for the deployed DPP serverless API
stores.fields: event, timestamp_ms, request_id, API surface, HTTP method/status, outcome, duration_ms, auth-present boolean and stable public error code; request/response bodies, query parameters, bearer/access/refresh tokens, Supabase keys, cookies, emails/phones, passport identifiers and raw IP addresses are prohibited

retention.current_behavior: Structured dpp_http_request events are emitted by the deployed API and can be queried through Vercel runtime observability; the accepted production retention period/backend ownership policy is not yet recorded.

controls: X-Request-ID accepts only a bounded safe pattern; unsafe/missing IDs are replaced by UUID v4
logs contain only the R09 allowlisted structured fields
request/response bodies, query parameters, credentials, cookies, direct identifiers and raw IP addresses are prohibited
logging sink failure is fail-open for the original HTTP response

out_of_scope_shared_project_data: All non-dpp_* application tables in the shared Supabase project are owned by other applications and are not part of DPP Autopilot privacy inventory.
green_blockers: M01-M13 declared dependencies are not all GREEN.

Final regulatory/operational retention periods remain unaccepted for passports/history, registry submissions, evidence and audit snapshots; audit credential-key redaction is only a technical minimization precursor.

External registry recipient terms and live payload scope are not accepted.
